title: Quantum Computing Advances
description: Exploring the next generation of quantum algorithms for scalable computation.
pageHtml:
Quantum Computing Advances

This project explores how next-generation quantum algorithms can make large-scale computation more practical for emerging hardware.

Project overview

The work focuses on algorithm design, error reduction, and improving performance for medium-sized quantum systems.

Why it matters

These advances can enable new scientific simulations and optimization problems that classical computers struggle to solve.

title: Ocean Acidification Study
description: Collecting real-world data on ocean chemistry to inform climate policy.
pageHtml:
Ocean Acidification Study

This project investigates the impact of ocean acidification on marine ecosystems and informs climate policy decisions.

Project overview

The work focuses on data collection, analysis, and modeling to understand the long-term effects of increased CO2 absorption.

Why it matters

Understanding ocean acidification is crucial for predicting and mitigating its effects on biodiversity and coastal communities.

Microplastics in Rainwater Study

This project investigates the presence and impact of microplastics in urban rainwater systems.

Project overview

Why it matters

Understanding microplastic pollution in rainwater is essential for assessing environmental health and developing mitigation strategies.
